items.label: Quantum-Si Q2 FY2026 (08-13-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CEO: the Proteus launch timeline was updated from the end of 2026

set.signal: CEO: the Proteus launch timeline was updated from the end of 2026 to the second quarter of 2027. The primary driver is an additional integrated instrument design cycle before moving to production (prototypes were built and tested in 2025; integrated units were built and began testing in the first half of 2026), meant to reduce manufacturing risk and improve system repeatability; some internal units reliably perform at a very high level, above internal specifications, while others perform at or a bit below that level. Management said the decision came from an internal assessment, not new customer feedback, and is hardware-focused; reagent and consumable development is largely tracking to expectations. Management expects to finalize the design, build, test and confirm performance over the remainder of 2026 and, assuming that goes well, carry into the first half of 2027 toward a second-quarter launch.

items.reason: Units 'at or a bit below' refers to the very high level above spec, not below internal specifications; drop the program leadership / governance change (skill section 2: governance / personnel); keep the 'assuming that goes well' hedge.
items.evidence: some instruments reliably perform at a very high level, above our internal specifications, while others perform at or a bit below that level.
